02 / Timetable & import

Choose an .ics export from Sentral. Preview an import, then Apply to replace the saved timetable.

Your timetable is read on this device to show classes, rooms, teachers and times. Apply saves an encrypted local copy. Nothing is sent to a server. Privacy policy

Stored only in this browser. Re-import when your timetable changes. No Sentral login or automatic sync.

03 / Display

Keep your countdown open while you work.

Press Esc for page fullscreen or F11 for a fullscreen window. On iPhone or iPad, use Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the browser menu → Add to Home screen. Fullscreen availability depends on your browser. Keep the app open for the live countdown; background reminders are available in the desktop extension.

04 / Help · Import your timetable

Start with your school's Sentral student portal. These examples show one portal layout; your school may look a little different.

  1. Choose Student & sign in

    Open your school's official Sentral portal, choose Student, then sign in with your school account. Afterbell does not need your login.

  2. Find your timetable

    On the Home dashboard, find the panel labelled with your name and Timetable. Click the heading or arrow to expand it.

  3. Export as ICS

    Click Export as ICS near View full timetable. Save the downloaded .ics file, usually in Downloads. Do not choose a PDF or screenshot.

  4. Import into Afterbell

    Open Settings → Timetable & import → Import timetable. Choose the downloaded .ics file. Review the imported classes in the preview, then click Apply changes to save.

  5. Check & make it yours

    Check the school time zone and today's classes. Choose your clock style under Appearance. Import a new export after your timetable changes; it replaces the saved timetable.

Need a hand?

No export link? Try the student portal in a desktop browser and expand Timetable. If your school has disabled export, ask the school for an ICS timetable.

No class right now? Between classes, Afterbell shows the next class. Use the date picker to check another day. If the export has ended, import a newer one.

Wrong times? Check the school time zone under Timetable & import and your computer's clock.

Safe to share? Your ICS file contains personal timetable information, so keep it private.

Click any tutorial image to see it larger. All help images are bundled locally.

05 / Notifications

Get a reminder before each class, even with Afterbell closed. Enable reminders, choose your settings, then Apply. Chrome will ask for notification/sound permissions.

Class details can appear on your lock screen if enabled. Leave them hidden for a discreet reminder. Sound volume affects Afterbell tones and uploads; system sound uses your OS volume.

Chrome must be running. Sleeping devices, Chrome scheduling and Do Not Disturb can delay or suppress alerts. A missed reminder may appear after waking if the class has not started.

06 / Privacy & local data

Afterbell only uses your timetable and chosen background on this device. No analytics, ads, accounts, data sale or cloud sync. The web app stores data in this browser. It does not send your timetable or media to a server. Browser data and the desktop extension are separate; import your timetable on each device. Clearing site data or using private browsing can remove your saved data.

Timetable data and backgrounds are encrypted locally. Your unlocked browser can still display them; this is not a password-protected vault.
